usage: Common everyday noun for the activity of dancing; often used when talking about a hobby, performance, or event.
Can appear after verbs like "鍾意" or "學" to talk about liking or learning dance.
Also used in fixed expressions and casual speech for social dancing, stage dancing, or dance classes.
Neutral and very common; suitable for both spoken Cantonese and general writing.
